name: wlt-finance-settlement-reconciliation
executionConcern: Control Panel finance, WLT wallet/ledger/payment/refund/COD, destinations/payouts, settlements/commissions/reconciliation and direct financial readbacks
objective: Eliminate parallel financial truth and make every Control Panel financial action a governed WLT-owned transition with evidence, idempotency, reconciliation and canonical readback.
truthOwner: WLT exclusively owns all monetary state and value-changing financial effects; DSH contributes operational evidence/references only and Control Panel is presentation/orchestration.

tasks.objective: Close wallet, payment, refund and COD financial truth
tasks.currentProblem: Finance presentation/facade code can be mistaken for monetary ownership, while ambiguous external outcomes or duplicated COD effects can move money twice.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace finance route and payment-session/COD/ledger inspectors through DSH references into WLT contracts/backend/database; enforce double-entry, server-owned purpose/allocation, atomic COD reserve/release/finalize, refund source routing, idempotency and unknown-result reconciliation.
tasks.targetState: Every value-changing effect is one WLT ledger transaction chain with deterministic identity and canonical readback; no DSH/frontend balance or amount truth remains.
tasks.action: Repair at WLT owner or DSH-to-WLT evidence binding, migrate presentation consumers and delete duplicate calculations/fallbacks after verification.
mustNotChange: Do not direct-edit wallet or ledger balances.
Do not retry an ambiguous external money mutation through another route before reconciliation.
Do not let DSH/frontend calculate authoritative WLT amounts.
acceptanceCriteria: Double-entry and financial invariants hold under retries/concurrency.
COD/refund/payment transitions have one authoritative WLT effect and readback.
Unknown external results block duplicate money movement until reconciled.
tasks.rollback: Use WLT reversal/forward correction mechanisms compatible with immutable ledger/audit evidence; never erase historical financial effects.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused WLT monetary-core/binding commit with migrations only when owner invariants require them.

tasks.objective: Close destinations, payouts, settlements, commissions and reconciliation
tasks.currentProblem: Legacy payout/settlement semantics can allow unverified destinations, mutable approved facts, bare completion, weak separation or unreconciled external evidence.
tasks.requiredChange: Use one WLT payout engine and versioned official-wallet destinations; bind approval to immutable beneficiary/destination/amount/policy snapshot, freeze batches/control totals, record execution evidence, independently verify/reconcile, and enforce commission/settlement policy versions and legal transitions.
tasks.targetState: Payout/settlement/commission completion is evidence-backed, separation-of-duties-safe, immutable where required, reconciled and fully auditable.
tasks.action: Repair WLT state machines/database constraints and DSH evidence facade; migrate Control Panel panels to canonical commands/readback and remove bare mark-paid or local completion paths.
mustNotChange: Do not activate an unverified destination.
Do not mutate approved/frozen snapshots in place.
Do not self-approve or collapse preparation/approval/execution/reconciliation roles where policy separates them.
acceptanceCriteria: Destination changes require re-verification and sensitive identifiers stay protected.
Approved/frozen payout facts are immutable and completion requires required evidence/reconciliation.
Commission/settlement amounts derive from WLT policy and durable DSH evidence, never caller-supplied authoritative amounts.
tasks.rollback: Roll forward using governed reversal/exception handling and preserve immutable batch/evidence/audit history.

tasks.currentProblem: Even correct WLT state can be undermined if a direct surface displays local balances, stale settlement labels or another actor's data after Control Panel actions.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace only Product Truth-required financial consumers, enforce actor scope and read-only canonical projections, preserve pending/held/unknown/error states and refresh after committed operator transitions.
tasks.targetState: All directly affected surfaces show the same authorized WLT lifecycle without local financial calculation or cross-actor disclosure.
tasks.action: Migrate direct consumers to canonical WLT/approved DSH references and remove obsolete local financial truth after compatibility checks.
mustNotChange: Do not broaden into unrelated mobile features.
Do not infer withdrawable amount from visible balance unless WLT policy exposes it.
Do not allow one actor to read another actor financial detail.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct financial consumers are actor-scoped and canonical.
Pending/held/unknown/error states are distinct from completed success.
No direct surface contains an authoritative local monetary calculation.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation mapping only if it does not restore local financial truth; otherwise roll forward to canonical WLT projection.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused direct-consumer compatibility commit after WLT owner state is correct.
